name: sloth-skill-tree
description: Maycrest Group skills marketplace — six plugins spanning Create, Secure, Automate, Ops, Command, and Method (the Sloth Flow discipline engine).

plugins.name: maycrest-command
plugins.description: Maycrest Command — Sloth Command strategic orchestrator with task decomposition, parallel execution, and CI/PR integration, plus Sloth Dispatch fast router, agent registry, voice personas, brand tokens, and session hooks.

plugins.name: maycrest-create
plugins.description: Maycrest Create — specialists for design, marketing, paid media, content creation, brand, social strategy, AI video, cultural intelligence, theming, and visual art.

plugins.name: maycrest-automate
plugins.description: Maycrest Automate — specialists for full-stack engineering, AI, DevOps, spatial computing, gamedev, product, research, and web artifact development.

plugins.name: maycrest-secure
plugins.description: Maycrest Secure — specialists for security engineering, threat intelligence, incident response, forensics, offensive security, and compliance.

plugins.name: maycrest-ops
plugins.description: Maycrest Ops — specialists for project management, QA/testing, support, finance, analytics, studio operations, and document tooling (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf).

plugins.name: maycrest-method
plugins.description: Maycrest Method — the Sloth Flow discipline engine: ten process skills (spec, blueprint, TDD, debug, build, review, verify, ship) plus the /deliver client-build pipeline. Forked and rebranded from the MIT-licensed obra/superpowers; works standalone.
